Answer: B
Reason: The axial CT images demonstrate a right-sided pleural effusion (fluid density in the right hemithorax) and an abnormal collection of gas within the mediastinum surrounding the esophagus (indicated by the arrow), which is consistent with pneumomediastinum. In the context of a suspected aorto-oesophageal fistula, these findings are indicative of mediastinal abscess formation or leakage into the mediastinum.
